note: Chicago at zoom 15.5 and pitch 45 on the liberty base, which nothing else in the suite uses, turned to each of the four cardinal bearings. The page rotates the camera every frame, and a rotation has no state behind it, so the four bearings are four cameras. It found two faults, one on each side of the comparison. The first was this renderer's: a viewport-anchored light was never turned by the camera, so every wall was shaded as though the map had not rotated -- bearing 0 read 25 and 90, 180 and 270 read 25269, 16460 and 22070. Fixed in #212. The second was the oracle's, and it is the first of those: mbgl's `FillExtrusionBucket::lightPosition` called `transformMat3f(lightPos, lightPos, lightMat)`, which wrote the rotated x before reading the original, so the light's y was built from the already-rotated x. Reported as maplibre/maplibre-native#4658, fixed by #4662, backported to the pinned oracle. It read 83079 at bearing 225 and 7822 at 270; a sweep of eight bearings now reads 25, 50, 50, 9, 5, 36, 66 and 95. The page also removes the label layers, which needs a `remove_layer` the header does not have; the labels stay, and both renderers draw the same ones -- over the buildings rather than masked by them, which is what the oracle does too (at bearing 180 the two frames agree to 5 pixels of 786432 while both draw street names across the tower faces).
